version_series_meaning: This package is a data-only overlay, and model_card_version names this overlay's own artifacts. The model graph its rows decode through is the one base_weights names, at that package's own model_card_version. Neither number is package_version, which moves in lockstep across every mailwoman workspace on every release.

inherited_lineage.note: These entries are @mailwoman/neural-weights-en-us's record of what its model graph was trained on. This package ships no graph and contributed none of these rows. Read them as the base's lineage rather than as a claim about this package's own artifacts, which are listed under artifacts and attributed under training_attribution.

attribution.text: OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL-1.0): the training extracts of the 100 ODbL sources of corpus v0.7.10-gb-county, the per-country `osm-*` extracts read from Geofabrik extracts (the 2026-10-02 extracts for RU, IN, ID, NG, PK, VN and BD, and the 2026-10-16 and 2026-10-17 extracts for the countries added in #2663 and #2665), the `rendered-pk-register` and `rendered-bd-register` extracts rendered from OSM tuples, and the 49,219 `spliced-sub-venue` rows that carry an OpenStreetMap venue or sub-venue name. © OpenStreetMap contributors, https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright. Corpus v0.8.22-retention-overlay reads v0.8.18's osm extracts, as v0.8.21 did, which render 30% of the osm sources' rows with a trailing country name. The extracts are Derivative Databases under ODbL 1.0, the effective training manifest packages/corpus/data/training-manifests/v0.8.22-retention-overlay.effective.json records what reached the trainer, and they are published under ODbL 1.0 at https://huggingface.co/datasets/sister-software/mailwoman-osm-training-extract.

data_access_offers.statement: The OpenStreetMap-derived training extracts of corpus v0.8.22-retention-overlay, © OpenStreetMap contributors. Corpus v0.8.22 lists the same 101 osm-family parquet files as v0.8.21, by path and sha256. Corpus v0.8.21 reads its osm sources from the v0.8.18 overlay's parquet files, and each of its 102 ODbL sources holds the row count its v0.8.18 frozen record states, so the extracts are v0.8.18's: the 101 parquet files of the osm sources under data-v0.8.18/ (2,931,896 rows, 30% of them rendered with a trailing English country name), and the files of spliced-sub-venue, rendered-bd-register and rendered-pk-register under data/, which v0.8.18 holds unchanged from v0.7.10-gb-county. The dataset's MANIFEST.json at the revision named above lists every file with its sha256 and names model 10.8.0, trained on the same extracts, under produced_works.

entries.text: OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL-1.0): this overlay decodes through the `@mailwoman/neural-weights-en-us` model graph, which trained on OpenStreetMap-derived training extracts that package's card and effective training manifest record. © OpenStreetMap contributors, https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright.

unresolved: No digest is recorded for 7 of 7 declared artifacts: pair-index-it.bin, fst-it-it.bin, fst-street-morphology.bin, anchor-lexicon-v1.json, locality-surface-lexicon-v7.json, street-type-lexicon-v3.json, country-surface-lexicon-v1.json. An unrecorded digest is not a verified one.
This package's model card attributes only the OpenStreetMap data behind @mailwoman/neural-weights-en-us's graph. It ships 7 artifacts and no model graph, so its own inputs are unattributed here.

Which records trained the model this package ships or inherits is unresolved. `buildCorpus` writes a frozen `TRAINING_SOURCES.json` naming every source that contributed and under which terms, `effective-manifest.run.ts` derives from it and an `audit_epoch_mixture` output what one config's epoch drew, and no released model was built from a corpus carrying either. The corpus named above is the recipe's corpus rather than a record of what reached the model.
